urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to screenshot. Domains without https:// are accepted. Duplicates are removed automatically.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the visible viewport.

viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (desktop)
viewportWidth.description: Browser viewport width in pixels. Ignored when device is mobile.

viewportHeight.title: Viewport height (desktop)
viewportHeight.description: Browser viewport height in pixels. Ignored when device is mobile.

device.title: Device
device.description: Mobile emulates a mid-tier phone (390x844, deviceScaleFactor 3, mobile Chrome user agent) and ignores the viewport width/height fields.

format.title: Image format
format.description: Output image format stored in the key-value store.

jpegQuality.title: JPEG quality
jpegQuality.description: Compression quality for JPEG output (1-100). Ignored for PNG.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
enumTitles: networkidle2 (recommended: waits for the page to settle)
waitUntil.description: Navigation completion signal before the screenshot is taken.

delayMs.title: Extra delay before capture (ms)
delayMs.description: Extra wait after the page settles, useful for slow-loading animations or lazy content. Capped at 10 seconds.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Inject CSS that hides common cookie/consent banner elements (OneTrust, Cookiebot, etc.) before the screenshot. Never clicks "accept".

timeoutSecs.title: Per-page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to wait for a single page to load. One automatic retry on timeout.
